messages:
Ayan Gupta: Hi everyone! Ayan here, joining Eng-Platform today. Remote (GMT+1). Quick setup Qs: VPN+MDM steps, and who to ask for read access to the 'shared-models' bucket? Coffee: black espresso. Two truths & a lie: used to code in Fortran, once did improv comedy, I've never been on a plane. :wave:
Maya (Onboarding): Welcome Ayan!! Onboarding checklist sent. MDM link in your welcome email — follow the "Enroll Device" flow and paste the code. VPN is WireGuard; we'll auto-provision after MDM. I'll add you to #platform-sync and #oncall-rotations.
IT Support: Hey Ayan 3 laptop assigned (asset R-5563). For mac MDM issues: run `sudo profiles list` and if you see duplicate profiles remove the old one with `profiles -R -p <profile-uuid>`. WireGuard: `brew install wireguard-tools` then import the .conf we emailed.
DevX Bot: account-created: GitHub invite sent, calendar 1:1 scheduled with Eliot, Slack channels added.
Eliot: welcome! For bucket access, open infra request at https://intranet.redwood/infra-request, set project `shared-models`, role `storage.objectViewer` and tag me. If you need quick creds for a demo, ask and I can grant temporary access.
Ayan Gupta: Thanks—one more: where do we grab the starter datasets and a tiny model to run locally?
Noah Simms: Starter repo: `git@github.com:redwood/dev-starter.git` -> `cd dev-starter && make setup && make run-local MODEL=redwood-tiny`. If you hit CUDA OOM on laptop, try CPU mode `make run-local MODEL=redwood-tiny DEVICE=cpu`.
IT Support: Monitor/headset requests: https://intranet.redwood/equipment-request -> choose "peripherals" -> priority "new hire". If you want a mechanical keyboard, fill notes with layout preference.
Maya (Onboarding): When you have a minute, post a 1-paragraph intro in #general (people love fun facts). Also join the new hires lunch on Friday at 12pm PT.
Ayan Gupta: Great—thanks all! Fun fact for #general: I can juggle code and oranges at the same time (maybe that's the lie). :orange: :computer:
